system.description:
Trigger: You make an FBA attack or use a Combo Skill.

Crashing Knee | Trigger — Light FBA/Combo: You deal damage equal to [3 x Soul] and on an Excellent, you cause the creature to become Senseless until the start of their turn.

Cutting Kick | Trigger — Heavy FBA/Combo: Your attack gains [Sunder] and deals damage equal to [2 x Soul]. This damage ignores Armor and magykal effects like Wards.

Organ Crusher | Trigger — Grab FBA/Combo: Deal damage equal to [2 x Soul]. Your Target rolls Physical Resistance. On failure they become Stunned and suffers internal injuries, gaining 5 Bleeding Wounds that can not be cleansed with Bandages or the Dark Cleanse monster ability.
